title: Chicken and Mushroom Risotto
description: An oven-baked risotto with chicken, mushrooms, garlic and onion, finished with basil and black pepper.
imageAlt: Creamy chicken and mushroom risotto with black pepper and basil in a sage-grey bowl.
imageCaption: Cookbook image · chicken and mushroom risotto
personalNote: Chicken and mushroom this time. Keep the Parmesan at the table, and leave the second dinner without cheese if we want it dairy-free.
equipment: Large oven-safe pot with an oven-safe lid
advancePrep: Cut the chicken into small pieces. Clean and slice the mushrooms. Peel and chop the garlic and onion, and pick the basil leaves off the stalks.
importantNotes: Four portions means two dinners for both of us. If the second night’s portions are smaller, we can have garlic bread with them. Use 500 g chicken and 400 g mushrooms for the batch, and leave the rice unwashed. Taste for salt only after the chicken is fully cooked. Keep Parmesan separate and choose dairy-free stock if we want the second dinner dairy-free. We can swap the chicken for 300 g sausage or 500 g of 5% lean pork mince; check the swap note for the cooking changes. Times are estimates.

ingredients.name: Basil leaves
ingredients.note: Pick the leaves off the stalks.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.note: Only if needed after the chicken is fully cooked.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.note: Add to individual servings if wanted; leave off the dairy-free second-dinner portions.

groups.title: If we want a little extra on night two

ingredients.name: Garlic bread
ingredients.note: Optional with the second dinner if we ate a bit more on the first night. Heat following the packet.

steps.title: Prepare and preheat
steps.description: Peel and chop the garlic and onion, cut the chicken into small pieces, and clean and slice the mushrooms. Pick the basil leaves. Put the oven on at 180°C and boil the measured water.

steps.title: Start the chicken, onion and garlic
steps.description: Put the chicken, onion and garlic in the oven-safe pot on medium heat. Squish them around for about 5 minutes, until the onion starts softening and the chicken goes white on the outside. It still needs the rest of the cooking, so don’t taste it yet.
steps.doneness: Softening onion and chicken white on the outside.
steps.warning: The chicken is not necessarily cooked through yet. Do not taste it or the cooking liquid at this stage.

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms
steps.description: Add the mushrooms and squish them around for about 5–8 minutes. We want them soft and letting out their water, with some of that liquid starting to cook down.
steps.doneness: Soft mushrooms, with their released liquid starting to reduce.
steps.tip: The 5-minute timer is a first check; keep cooking if the mushrooms need longer.

steps.title: Add the rice and stock
steps.description: Add the unwashed risotto rice and stock cubes, mix them through, then pour in the boiled water. Give it another mix and bring it to the boil. We’ll taste for salt after the chicken is fully cooked.
steps.warning: Wait until the chicken is fully cooked before tasting the liquid. Check the seasoning after baking.

steps.title: Bake the covered risotto
steps.description: Once it’s boiling, put the oven-safe lid on and move it into the oven for 30 minutes. Check both the rice and chicken are cooked through before we eat. Use the oven gloves—the handles stay hot afterwards too.
steps.doneness: Cooked risotto rice and fully cooked chicken.
steps.tip: A thermometer check for the chicken is 75°C in the centre for 30 seconds. If it has not reached that, continue cooking and check again.
steps.warning: Use oven gloves: the pot, lid and handles will stay hot after baking.

steps.title: Finish with pepper and basil
steps.description: Once the chicken is cooked, taste and add salt only if it needs it. Remember the Parmesan adds saltiness too. Mix in the black pepper and basil leaves.
steps.tip: Better a little less salty than too salty: you can add salt, but you can’t remove it.

steps.title: Dinner tonight, and a little help for night two
steps.description: Serve tonight’s dinner with Parmesan at the table, and keep the second dinner aside. If we end up having a bit more tonight, we can serve the smaller second dinner with garlic bread; heat it following the packet.
steps.tip: Add cheese to individual plates instead of mixing it into the whole pot.

substitutions.title: Swap the protein
substitutions.text: For this original batch, interchange 300 g sausage with 500 g chicken or 500 g of 5% lean pork mince. The numbered ingredient quantities scale with the portion control, but these swap quantities describe the batch. Air-fry sausage until fully cooked according to its packet, then slice it. For chicken, cut into small pieces and cook it in the pot with the aromatics; it must be fully cooked by the end of baking. For pork mince, break it up in the pot and cook it through before continuing. If using raw chicken or mince, wait until the meat is fully cooked before tasting the cooking liquid.

substitutions.title: Black pepper
substitutions.text: Coarsely crushed pepper or pepper powder both work.

substitutions.title: Dairy-free second-dinner portions
substitutions.text: Leave Parmesan off those portions and use stock cubes without dairy ingredients. If swapping in sausage, check that it is dairy-free too.

troubleshooting.title: Keeping the rice creamy
troubleshooting.text: Do not wash the risotto rice; its starch makes the finished dish creamy.

troubleshooting.title: Mushrooms still firm?
troubleshooting.text: Use their softness and released liquid as the guide. The 5-minute timer is only the first check.

storage: Put the second dinner into small containers so it cools quickly, ideally within 1 hour. Keep it in the fridge and eat within 24 hours. Freeze it if we’re saving it longer, and keep Parmesan separate if we want it dairy-free.
reheating: Reheat once until steaming hot throughout. Stir or turn it during microwave reheating to avoid cold pockets.
foodSafety: Chicken and pork mince must be fully cooked before tasting the liquid or serving. A thermometer check is 75°C in the centre for 30 seconds. Keep utensils used for raw meat separate from the finished food. Use oven gloves for the pot and lid.
servingSuggestion: Two dinners for both of us. Add Parmesan to individual plates if we want it. If we eat a bit more on the first night, serve the second dinner with garlic bread.
